content: Trying to wrap my head around why would someone configure two times the same builder url with a different auth data, what is the use case?

author: jimmygchen
content: Maybe connecting to a middleware (eg commit boost as url)  and different auth data for each builder?

author: jvranek
content: yes this is how commit-boost works post-gloas, `url = cb.example.com` , `auth_data = builder.example.com`
